coordinate_convention.rectangles: [left, top, right, bottom), pixels; x right, y down
coordinate_convention.landmarks: Manual visual estimates unless explicitly alpha-measured; hidden anatomy is not measured.
coordinate_convention.head_core: Cranial envelope excluding ears, sprout and robot side modules where separable; not an alpha crop.

canonical.ground_measurement: bottom edge of alpha bounds; contact approximation
canonical.notes: Preserved byte-for-byte; this remains the identity authority if generated views disagree.

layout.note: Explicit unequal row rectangles keep the adjusted standing sprout inside its cell; the seated row ends at y494.

turnaround.background: opaque neutral gray; reference-only, not a transparent animation frame
turnaround.tool: Built-in image_gen local patches and previously authorized Python/Pillow regional compositing; Mobi head uses a source-part transform after two generated candidates failed the size target.

review.authority: User requested correction of the preceding full reference review; regional Python/Pillow compositing authorization is retained from issue 396.
checks: Inspected current full sheet and enlarged before/after crops for the requested correction, identity, proportions, occlusion and smooth patch boundaries.
Confirmed unchanged canvas/mode and zero changed pixels outside the current edit mask; retained prior regional correction provenance.
Static reference acceptance only; existing animation clips and device rendering were not validated.
corrections: Seated wheel-holding rear view retains only narrow upper-arm edges below the head; forward hands and feet are occluded by the torso. Do not widen the torso to hide limbs.

Match the seated rear upper-arm silhouettes in mobi_goggles: slender vertical oval crescents hugging the torso, with upper endpoints hidden under the head and smooth outward-then-inward curves. No horizontal fin, free top tip or shoulder shelf.

Standing side head uses a 1.055 uniform adjustment of the existing head about neck anchor [769,838], eased to the original neck over y824..848. Face identity, seated row, body below y849 and floor contact remain unchanged.
limits: Mobi rear anatomy is a conservative generated interpretation; the canonical image does not show the back.
Side views are left-facing oblique/profile references, not calibrated 90-degree orthographic projections.

compositing.method: Localized source-part head scaling with smooth neck attachment

previous_revision.method: Original RGB plus reviewed generated patches

followup.method: Original pixels plus reviewed image_gen patches; original gray backdrop preserved or reconstructed where old geometry was removed.

latest_revision.method: Original pixels plus reviewed image_gen patches; original gray backdrop preserved or reconstructed where old geometry was removed.

correction_reference.scope: Upper-arm attachment and silhouette selected by the user; goggles are not applied to the base character.

identity_constraints: Two cyan-to-lilac sprout leaves on a short cyan stem; never upright rabbit ears.
Pearl-white rounded head, drooping ears, black oval eyes, pink cheeks and curved smile.
Compact soft body and short rounded limbs; no tail is established by the canonical front. Rear reference uses a plain back.
Seated wheel-holding rear view retains only narrow upper-arm edges below the head; forward hands and feet are occluded by the torso. Do not widen the torso to hide limbs.

Match the seated rear upper-arm silhouettes in mobi_goggles: slender vertical oval crescents hugging the torso, with upper endpoints hidden under the head and smooth outward-then-inward curves. No horizontal fin, free top tip or shoulder shelf.

pose_selection.locomotion: Use standing reference to expose limb attachments; add action-specific key poses before generating a cycle.

animation_contract.default_prop_policy: Wheel is a seated pose prop, not equipped clothing. Empty-handed standing is an additional anatomy reference, not an app appearance replacement.
animation_contract.scale: Choose one anatomical scale from the canonical head width. Reuse it for a whole clip; never fit each frame independently to its nontransparent bounds.
animation_contract.anchors: Keep a fixed root and ground plane; represent jumping and travel as intentional root offsets. Preserve crop offsets when exporting trimmed frames.

review_tolerances.status: initial review thresholds, not anatomical truth

animation_contract.rendering: Use one renderer-specific transform per clip/pose, not per-frame auto-centering. Do not impose identical whole-body heights on seated and standing poses.
animation_contract.validation: Review actual-size playback, contact points, loop seam and transitions into/out of seated idle; static references alone do not validate motion.
